name: Arc Golem (TEST)

triggers.note: capability.knockback's second variant: the same mechanism as trigger.halberd.hack.knockback, pure data on the test body.
Thorns, test lane (fix.status-damage-types): RULED 'Thorns damage that is dealt is true damage.'

fix.activation-end-fires: the golem braces at the end of every Activation it takes — the first content that DEPENDS on the hook firing. Fires once per Activation, idle ones included. Value 2, not 1: rung 3 (the status tick) follows rung 2 in the same ladder and decays a pool by 1, exactly as embers catch-then-cook — so 1 would be gone before anyone could read it.
fix.unit-tags: a type-filtered rider — fires only when the struck unit IS undead, read off tags, the one field. Proves requireTags reaches real rows.
capability.root (2026-09-03): the sweep holds what it hits (the sweep never rolls to hit, so it lands every swing) — the second live Root, pure data.
capability.taunt (2026-09-03): whatever bites the golem is called — taunted by the golem, it fixates on it. onTakingDamage, so the attacker is the target. Pure data.
capability.karma (2026-09-03): the golem gathers Karma when struck — heals it receives grow by it, its hits by half of it, and each kill takes one. Pure data.
capability.shadow (2026-09-03): the sweep shades what it hits; Shadow grows each tick and obliterates at Max Health. Pure data.
capability.confusion (2026-09-03): the sweep addles what it hits — the zombie runs a different AI while it lasts. Pure data.
capability.corpses (2026-09-03): the golem grinds the bodies within 2 at the end of its Activation, 1 Health each — the second consumer, pure data.

fix.knockback-beyond-one (2026-09-04): a push of TWO — 'We want to be able to have knockback that is greater than one' (Angela 2026-09-04). Same mechanism as the halberd's 1 and the sweep's 1; the number is the row's.

note: A complete body, not a delta — no real unit is a 30-hp, 5-accuracy stone that never rolls to hit. capability.area-attack / capability.knockback / station.crit-count scaffolding; fields ONLY in showcase.arc-variant. Re-statted 2026-08-27: the original 14-hp body died before a single-target turn. | fix.knockback-beyond-one (2026-09-04), FINDING 35: accuracy was 5 — read as the whole base chance, the Slam hit 5% of the time and the Overhead (−10) NEVER hit in 40 seeds of its own verify scenario; every rider hung on the Overhead was dead content. 65, like a hero.

auras.note: capability.auras (2026-09-03): the golem is hard to look at — enemies adjacent to it lose 10 Accuracy while adjacent. The second aura, pure data, on a body the probe fields.
